Quarto supports TeX math through MathJax:

$$
\sum_{k=1}^{n} k = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}
$$

It also supports Observable JS cells for browser-side interactive work.

```{ojs}
viewof n = Inputs.range([1, 200], {value: 32, step: 1, label: "n"})
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  marks: [
    Plot.lineY(
      d3.range(1, n + 1).map((x) => ({x, y: x * (x + 1) / 2})),
      {x: "x", y: "y"}
    )
  ]
})
```
